title: Independent Critic Rubric
summary: 100-point rubric used by the independent critique step. Pass requires >=85 with zero critical defects and no more than three revisions.

MUST.text: Score every proposal against all eight criteria below; do not skip a criterion.
Deduct points only with evidence; every deduction states the user consequence.
A critical defect (task blocker, data-loss risk, deceptive action/pricing, severe privacy/security or critical accessibility barrier) blocks regardless of score.

SHOULD.text: Separate facts, assumptions and hypotheses in the evidence column.

AVOID.text: Do not treat a fetched doc ID as proof that a source semantically supports a claim.

FAILURE_MODES: A high score can hide a critical defect; check critical defects before score.
Evidence quality is the weakest criterion to fake; verify sources.
Three revisions exhausted means the proposal needs re-scoping, not more polish.

checks.text: Every deduction has evidence and user consequence?
